# Retro Windows

Retro Windows recreates a Windows 3.1 interface inside Obsidian with gray panels, 3D-effect buttons, blue title bars and pixelated typography. Light and dark variants are offered, folders are colour-coded, and Markdown styling for code blocks, headings and lists is adjusted to match.

![Retro Windows screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codeisconfusing/retro-windows-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Retro Windows"
    author: "codeisconfusing"
    repo:   "codeisconfusing/retro-windows-obsidian"
    slug:   "retro-windows"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/retro-windows"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/codeisconfusing/retro-windows-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/codeisconfusing/retro-windows-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a classic Windows 3.1 look to Obsidian with gray panels, 3D-effect buttons, blue title bars, and pixelated typography. Choose light or dark variants, use color-coded folders and vintage-styled UI elements, and get custom Markdown styling for code blocks, headings, and lists."
}
```
